verdict.rationale: Omnara supports live chat-style interaction with agents — sending corrections, queuing tasks, and answering agent questions (omnara-docs-7, omnara-docs-8) — and offers a first-party Slack connector plus dashboard for this (omnara-gh-3), which covers discussing/delegating tasks conversationally. However there's no documented '@mention'/tagging mechanism specifically, nor evidence of GitHub issue/PR thread integration for delegation. Missing for 10: explicit tag/mention syntax in a chat thread, GitHub-thread-based delegation workflow, and independent confirmation of this specific interaction pattern.
